stepNotes.1: Single-file unit confirmed: tray.mjs exports only createTrayController@97 and returns {update@305, destroy@328}; seven private pure helpers, all side-effect free.
stepNotes.2: No secrets, spawn, fs writes, or network in this module; nativeImage.createFromPath@89 only consumes caller-supplied bundle paths from main.js:2040 trayIconAssets — no path-traversal vector inside the unit.
stepNotes.3: update@305 coerces non-object snapshots to {}, applyIconState@142 re-checks tray.isDestroyed on every tick (127-139) and destroy@328 is idempotent; the one iconState-before-guard assignment is rendered benign by the next update re-deriving it.
stepNotes.4: Only recurring timer is the busy animation setInterval@127 (ANIM_INTERVAL_MS=75), always torn down by stopAnim on idle/unseen/destroy; setToolTip and setContextMenu run unconditionally each update but arrays are capped at MAX_SESSIONS=8 / MAX_APPROVALS=10.
stepNotes.5: Presentation/state/routing boundary is clean and documented in the header (12-16); onAction@97 is the single inversion-of-control callback, consumed solely by dispatchTrayAction@main.js:1993; statusIconPaths.blank is an implicit contract worth one assertion.
stepNotes.6: No empty catches, no TODOs, no commented code, no unused imports; MAX_SESSIONS/MAX_APPROVALS/ANIM_INTERVAL_MS are named constants; overflow for approvals (234-240) and sessions (259-265) is surfaced as N more submenus, not silent truncation.
stepNotes.7: Snapshot is trusted: approval.id/sessionId@188,208 and session.id@251 forwarded verbatim into onAction — acceptable within the renderer trust domain but the one place a renderer regression could silent-no-op; Number.isFinite@314 correctly guards the unseen reduce against NaN poisoning.
stepNotes.8: grep for createTrayController across *.test.* returns ZERO matches; the three MODULE-AUDIT test files are desktop hand-off / web UI / release workflow integration tests, not tray coverage — the seven pure helpers and {update,destroy} lifecycle have no automated tests.
stepNotes.9: No Critical/High/Medium findings accepted; findings/ is empty and consistent; actionable follow-ups are unit tests for the pure helpers, an optional snapshot-equality short-circuit in update, and an optional construction-time assertion on statusIconPaths.blank — none blocking; codex-sol independent verify still pending.
